# KB-Backed Troubleshooting — Complete Architecture Guide

Knowledge-base backed troubleshooting methodology matching crash signatures, server error codes, and known issues against MongoDB SERVER tickets and technical bulletins.

## System Architecture & Invariants
- [HIGH] (core) MongoDB error codes (e.g. 11000 duplicate key, 13435 not master, 50 plan cache error) distinguish fatal assertions from transient client-retriable exceptions.
- [HIGH] (methodology) Crash stack traces logged under mongod fatal assertions contain frame signatures that can be matched against public MongoDB Jira SERVER tickets.
- [MEDIUM] (antipatterns) Treating intermittent network disconnects (SocketException / InterruptedAtShutdown) as database crashes leads to inaccurate post-mortems and misconfigured failovers.
- [HIGH] (patterns) Correlate error code 11600 (InterruptedAtShutdown) with maintenance windows, rolling upgrades, or OS kernel OOM killer events in /var/log/messages.
- [HIGH] (troubleshooting) Symptom: Invariant failure in WiredTiger session. Cause: Corrupted block header or storage media bit rot. Fix: Restore from latest PITR snapshot or resync node from replica member.

## Primary Sources & Citations
- MongoDB Error Codes Definition Source: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/base/error_codes.err (repo)
- MongoDB Error Codes Reference: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/error-codes/ (docs)
- MongoDB Server Bug Tracker: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER (docs)
- WiredTiger Storage Engine Guide: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/wiredtiger-storage-engine/ (docs)
